brief.prompt: Create a phenomenal two-minute film showing why inference is essential to Physical AI. Show sophisticated NVIDIA Cosmos world-model inference and VLM evaluation, using authentic Token Factory Cosmos 3 Super Reasoner results, from a Nebius + NVIDIA perspective.
brief.audience: C-suite and technical leaders evaluating Physical AI inference
brief.goal: Make the need for world-model generation and vision-language evaluation tangible, and position Nebius infrastructure and NVIDIA Cosmos as complementary parts of the inference workflow.
brief.tone: Cinematic, ambitious, precise; short headlines and strong visual proof.

title: Before the
next move.
scenes.subtitle: Physical AI needs inference.
scenes.narration: Before a robot makes its next move, intelligence has work to do. That is where inference begins.

title: The world
keeps changing.
scenes.subtitle: New observations. New possibilities. New decisions.
scenes.narration: Training builds capability. Inference puts it to work: interpreting new observations, generating possible scenarios, and evaluating what happened.

title: Carry context forward.
Extend the world.
scenes.subtitle: A generated segment conditions the next request. Three requests form a 30-second sequence.
labels: NEXT SEGMENT · CONDITIONED ON THE FIRST
scenes.narration: With Cosmos, generation can continue from earlier frames. Here, each continuation carries visual context forward, building a longer sequence from connected inference calls.

title: Keep the structure.
Explore a new condition.
scenes.subtitle: The same generated source supplies edge controls for a new appearance.
scenes.narration: Now change the conditions. Edge guidance from the source helps steer a new generation. The scene shifts to dim, warm lighting while retaining recognizable structure.

title: Turn one world into another possibility.
scenes.subtitle: Source-conditioned generation creates another candidate to inspect.
scenes.narration: Generated possibilities expand the scenarios available for development. Preserve each candidate with its source and generation settings.

title: What does
the evidence show?
scenes.subtitle: Generation opens possibilities. Evaluation asks harder questions.
scenes.narration: A convincing image raises another question. What does the evidence actually support? That calls for evaluation.

scenes.eyebrow: VLM EVALUATION / A SEPARATE RECORDED ROBOT RUN
title: Give the evaluator evidence and a task.
scenes.subtitle: Task: move the object to the target while maintaining stable contact.
labels: EIGHT ORIGINAL SELECTED FRAMES · ISAAC SIMULATION · RECORDED 27 AUG 2026
scenes.narration: For this separate robot experiment, eight selected frames and a manipulation task went to a vision language evaluator through Nebius Token Factory.

title: Ask what
happened.
scenes.subtitle: Requested model: Cosmos 3 Super Reasoner
scenes.narration: The report lists Cosmos Three Super Reasoner as the requested model. The recorded assessment flags inaccurate final placement, giving the next experiment specific feedback.
scenes.quote: “The object does not reach the intended target position, and the final placement is inaccurate.”
source_notes: Requested-model attribution; returned model identity was not retained.

title: Make the result actionable.
scenes.subtitle: Preserve the critique, the inputs, and the recorded outcome.
labels: MODEL ASSESSMENT · NOT INDEPENDENT PHYSICAL GROUND TRUTH
scenes.narration: The report records no task success. Preserve the critique and inputs, giving the next experiment a specific problem to investigate.

title: Generate possibilities.
Evaluate evidence.
scenes.subtitle: Complementary workloads, shown through separate recorded examples.
scenes.narration: World models generate candidates. Vision language models assess observations. Both support an iterative development loop, grounded in evidence.

title: Make inference
part of the loop.
scenes.subtitle: GPU generation. Hosted evaluation. Traceable artifacts.
labels: WORLD MODEL GPU RUN + SEPARATE ARCHIVED TOKEN FACTORY EVALUATION
scenes.narration: Nebius infrastructure and NVIDIA Cosmos bring generation and reasoning into the physical A I development loop.

title: Build what comes next.
scenes.subtitle: Explore the inference workflows.
scenes.narration: Explore physical A I inference with Nebius and NVIDIA. Start with a world. Ask better questions. Build on the evidence.
